analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($71,875.96) vs SMA5 ($66,629.55)/SMA20 ($64,533.31)/SMA50 ($64,210.42) — Above short/mid-term trends, confirming bullish position.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($66,150.53)/SMA200 ($68,969.58) — Above mid/long-term trends, maintaining strong uptrend strength.
· 52-week position (20.6%) + Approaching historical high levels.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.1→78.7) — Exited oversold territory and entered overbought, confirming strong upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-151.7786→733.8039) — Turned from negative to positive and continues to improve, confirming bullish trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near upper band $68,867.81) — Approaching upper band, indicating potential for further upside.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($66,803.65) — Based on SMA100 and 50-day moving averages, acting as a defense line during short-term pullbacks.
· Swing resistance ($71,985.74) — Expectation of further upside upon breaking previous high.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) — Confirming continuation of uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (3.16x vs 5-day average) — Surge in volume accompanying upward movement, increasing reliability.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) — High probability of uptrend continuation due to RSI entering overbought and volume surge; consideration for entry.
